blocks.orig: Manya Luxury Camp brings you close to nature in the heart of Serengeti National Park while keeping you comfortable in spacious, elegantly designed tents. The camp features 7 ensuite tents in double, twin, triple, and family configurations, so there’s a space for you whether you’re travelling as a couple, with friends, or with kids. Your tent comes with plush beds, an ensuite bathroom with hot showers, mosquito nets, and a private veranda with views across the Serengeti plains. The camp’s restaurant serves dishes prepared with local ingredients and international influences, alongside local cuisine and outdoor dining experiences. Before or after dinner, you can head to the bar to enjoy the view of the vast savannah with a drink in hand.

There are 7 en-suite tents in double, twin, triple and family layouts, so you’ll find the right space whether you’re travelling as a couple, with friends or with children. Each tent has comfortable beds, an en-suite bathroom with hot showers, mosquito nets and a private veranda looking out over the Serengeti plains. In the camp’s restaurant you can eat dishes made with local ingredients and international influences, as well as local cuisine and meals served outdoors. Before or after dinner, take a drink to the bar and enjoy the view over the wide savannah.
